title: Goofy Ahh Baby
blurb: Infant audio dragged into the goofy ahh dimension, where nothing is permitted to remain sincere for long. It is chaotic, slightly wrong, and inexplicably funny — the sound of the youngest possible generation apparently already committed to the bit. The genre works by taking something that has no business being distorted and distorting it anyway, and babies are about as far from ironic as a source gets. Play it over baby content, over adults behaving childishly, and over anybody's origin story. Born goofy, exactly as the prophecy foretold.
